archive_document.description:
Soft-delete (archive) a document.

The document is hidden from search results but is NOT immediately deleted. Vectors and the stored file remain until the garbage collector runs after the grace window (default 24 h).

Use `restore_document` to recover the document within the grace window. `delete_document` (served with `--tools all`) deletes immediately and irreversibly.

Returns: Updated document metadata as JSON.

document_id.description: ID of the document to archive.
document_id.title: Document Id

session_id.description: Session that owns the document. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

bulk_delete_session.description:
Delete ALL documents in a session at once.

This is a destructive, irreversible operation.  Use with care. The `confirm` flag must be set to `true` as a safety guard.

Returns: JSON with counts: requested, deleted, bytes_freed, errors.

admin_token.description: Required on a networked transport with `RAG_REQUIRE_AUTH` set, matching `DELETE /api/v1/sessions/{id}`.
admin_token.title: Admin Token

confirm.description: Must be `true` to proceed.  Safety guard.
confirm.title: Confirm

session_id.description: Session to wipe. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

clear_session.description:
Delete all documents in a session.

WARNING: This will permanently delete all documents and their indexed chunks for the specified session.

Returns: Confirmation or error message.

confirm.description: Must be set to True to confirm deletion.
confirm.title: Confirm

session_id.description: Session identifier; all documents in this session will be deleted. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

delete_document.description:
Delete a document and all its indexed chunks from the knowledge base.

The document must belong to the provided session_id. Both the vector index entries (Milvus) and the metadata record (SQLite) are removed, and the original file is deleted from disk.

Returns: Confirmation or error message.

session_id.description: Session identifier; used to verify ownership. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

delete_rag_profile.description:
Delete a custom RAG profile.

Built-in profiles (default, speed, standard, balanced, max_quality) cannot be deleted.

Returns: Confirmation message.

profile_name.description: Name of the profile to delete.
profile_name.title: Profile Name

session_id.description: Session identifier. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

get_active_profile.description:
Get the active RAG profile for a session.

Returns the currently active profile name and its configuration for the specified session.

Returns: JSON object with active profile name and resolved config.

session_id.description: Session identifier. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

get_document_chunks.description:
Get chunks from a specific document.

Retrieves the indexed text chunks for a document with pagination support. Useful for inspecting how a document was split.

Returns: List of chunks with their content and metadata.

limit.description: Maximum number of chunks to return.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Number of chunks to skip (for pagination).
offset.title: Offset

session_id.description: Session identifier; used to verify ownership. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

get_document_context.description:
Get document awareness context for the current session.

Returns information about available documents and adaptive guidance based on how many searches have been performed this turn. Helps agents decide when and how to use RAG search tools.

Returns: Formatted context string describing available documents, or empty string if no documents exist.

rag_search_count.description: Number of RAG searches done this turn (affects guidance).
rag_search_count.title: Rag Search Count

session_id.description: Session identifier. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

get_document_info.description:
Get detailed information about a specific document.

Returns comprehensive metadata including processing statistics, file information, and chunk details.

Returns: Detailed document information in JSON format.

session_id.description: Session identifier; used to verify ownership. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

get_document_status.description:
Get the processing status of a document (lightweight O(1) lookup).

Use this to poll for completion after an async upload (`upload_document` with `wait=false`).

Returns: JSON object with document_id, status, chunks_count, and error_message (if any).

session_id.description: Session identifier; used to verify ownership. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

get_focused_documents.description:
Get the currently focused document IDs for a session.

Returns: JSON object with focused document IDs.

session_id.description: Session identifier. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

get_gc_status.description:
Get the last garbage-collection run report.

Returns a summary of the most recent GC cycle including per-phase results (docs scanned, docs cleaned, bytes freed, errors) and whether the run was aborted due to the safety threshold.

The audit log is **server-wide**: `session_id` scopes the auth check, not the rows returned, which is why this takes the admin credential.

Returns: JSON GC report or error message.

admin_token.description: Required on a networked transport with `RAG_REQUIRE_AUTH` set: the report covers every session.
admin_token.title: Admin Token

session_id.description: Session identifier (used for auth resolution only). Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

get_lifecycle_policy.description:
Return the currently active lifecycle garbage-collection policy.

The policy governs:
- `soft_delete_grace_hours`: grace window before GC permanently removes soft-deleted docs
- `document_ttl_days`: auto-expiry TTL (null or 0 = disabled)
- `error_retention_days`: how long ERROR docs survive before soft-deletion
- `gc_cycle_hours`: interval between full GC cycles
- `orphan_scan_hours`: interval between orphan detection scans
- `safety_threshold_percent`: GC abort threshold (fraction of all docs)
- `batch_size`: documents per GC batch
- `reconcile_quota_on_startup`: rebuild quota counters at startup

Returns: JSON object with all policy fields and their current values.

admin_token.description: Required on a networked transport with `RAG_REQUIRE_AUTH` set, matching `GET /gc/policy`.
admin_token.title: Admin Token

session_id.description: Unused; policy is global, not per-session.
session_id.title: Session Id

get_profile_stats.description:
Get statistics about profiles and sessions.

Returns counts and limits for profiles and sessions, useful for monitoring and debugging.

Returns: JSON object with profile and session statistics.

session_id.description: Session identifier. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

get_rag_config.description:
Get the current RAG configuration for a session.

Returns the active profile and all configuration settings including chunking, embedding, reranking, and search parameters.

Returns: JSON object with full configuration.

session_id.description: Session identifier. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

get_system_status.description:
Get RAG system health and statistics.

Returns system status including Milvus connection, embedding model info, collection statistics, and configuration summary.

Returns: System status in JSON format.

list_documents.description:
List all documents in the knowledge base for a session.

Returns document metadata including processing status, file type, size, and number of indexed chunks.

Returns: Human-readable list of documents with their status.

session_id.description: Session identifier. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

list_profiles.description:
List available RAG configuration profiles.

Profiles control RAG behavior like chunk size, embedding model, reranking settings, and more. Users can create custom profiles to tune retrieval for different use cases.

Returns: JSON array of profile objects with name and description.

include_builtin.description: Whether to include built-in profiles (default True).
include_builtin.title: Include Builtin

session_id.description: Session identifier. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

patch_rag_config.description:
Apply configuration overrides to the current session.

Merges the provided settings with the active profile's config. These overrides persist for the session duration. Only retrieval and generation settings: the vector store, collection, paths, URLs and credentials are the server's, and a patch naming one is refused.

Returns: JSON object with updated configuration.

config_patch.description: JSON string with config keys to override. Example: '{"rerank_top_k": 10, "enable_reranking": false}'
config_patch.title: Config Patch

force.description: Apply a change of embedding model even when the session's documents would not be searched; reindex them afterwards with reindex_document.
force.title: Force

session_id.description: Session identifier. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

rebuild_collection.description:
Drop and recreate the vector collection for the session's embedding model.

Use when embedding dimensions or index settings change and there are no documents to reindex.

**This is not scoped to your session.** Each embedding model has its own collection, and every session on that model shares it (sessions are a filter within it), so a drop takes every session's documents on that model with it. The dimension check below means it only drops when the configured embedding dimension no longer matches the collection, but a caller can produce that mismatch themselves with one prior `patch_rag_config`. Hence the admin credential and the `confirm` flag that the strictly less destructive `bulk_delete_session` has always had.

admin_token.description: Required on a networked transport with `RAG_REQUIRE_AUTH` set.
admin_token.title: Admin Token

confirm.description: Must be `true` to proceed. Safety guard.
confirm.title: Confirm

session_id.description: Session identifier. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

reindex_document.description:
Reindex an existing document with the session's current settings.

Use it after changing the embedding model or the chunking. The document keeps answering searches from its old chunks until the new ones are stored, and a reindex that fails leaves it as it was.

Returns: Confirmation or error message.

force_rebuild.description: If true, recreate the collection at the configured embedding dimension when it differs, but only while the collection is empty. A collection holding documents is never dropped from here: every session's documents live in it.
force_rebuild.title: Force Rebuild

session_id.description: Session identifier; used to verify ownership. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

reset_rag_config.description:
Reset RAG configuration to defaults.

Returns: JSON object with reset configuration.

session_id.description: Session identifier. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

restore_document.description:
Restore a soft-deleted (archived) document to READY status.

Only possible within the grace window after archiving.  If the grace window has expired and the GC has already hard-deleted the document, this call will return an error.

Returns: Updated document metadata as JSON, or an error message.

document_id.description: ID of the archived document to restore.
document_id.title: Document Id

session_id.description: Session that owns the document. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

save_rag_profile.description:
Save a custom RAG profile.

Creates or updates a named profile with the provided configuration. Saved profiles persist across sessions and can be shared.

Returns: Confirmation message.

session_id.description: Session identifier. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

set_active.description: Whether to activate this profile (default True).
set_active.title: Set Active

search.description:
Search the knowledge base with the session's retrieval pipeline.

Returns formatted context with citations ready for LLM injection, plus a trailing `<search_metadata>` JSON block with structured citation data.

Retrieval behavior (hybrid search, reranking, HyDE, adaptive routing) is governed by the session configuration: callers only specify *what* to search and optional scope constraints.

Returns: Formatted context with citations, plus appended search_metadata JSON.

allow_broaden.description: If True, allows searching outside focused documents when focused scope is set for the session (explicit broadening).
allow_broaden.title: Allow Broaden

document_ids.description: Optional comma-separated list of document IDs to restrict the search to specific documents (e.g. "doc_abc,doc_def").
document_ids.title: Document Ids

session_id.description: Session identifier; only documents belonging to this session are searched. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

top_k.description: Optional override for the number of results to return. When `None` (default), uses the session config value.
top_k.title: Top K

set_active_profile.description:
Set the active RAG profile for a session.

Switches the session to use the specified profile for all subsequent RAG operations. This affects embedding model, chunking strategy, reranking settings, and more.

Returns: Confirmation message or error.

force.description: Switch even when the session's documents were embedded with another model and would not be searched; reindex them afterwards with reindex_document.
force.title: Force

profile_name.description: Name of the profile to activate: a preset (speed, standard, balanced, max_quality, default) or one saved with save_rag_profile.
profile_name.title: Profile Name

reindex.description: Reindex the session's documents with the new profile first, and switch only when every one is reindexed; if one fails, the session keeps its profile.
reindex.title: Reindex

session_id.description: Session identifier. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

set_focused_documents.description:
Set focused document IDs for a session.

When focused documents are set, all RAG searches will be scoped to only these documents. This is the server-side equivalent of the UI's "/" document picker feature.

Returns: Confirmation message.

document_ids.description: Comma-separated list of document IDs to focus on, or empty string to clear focus.
document_ids.title: Document Ids

session_id.description: Session identifier. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

set_lifecycle_policy.description:
Update lifecycle policy fields at runtime.

Changes take effect immediately for the current process but are **not persisted**: the server reverts to its configured defaults on restart. To make changes permanent, update `[rag.lifecycle]` in `settings.lasagna.toml` or set the corresponding `RAG_GC_*` env vars.

Unknown field names are rejected with an error.

Returns: JSON object with the full updated policy.

admin_token.description: Required on a networked transport with `RAG_REQUIRE_AUTH` set, matching `PATCH /gc/policy`.
admin_token.title: Admin Token

policy_updates.description: JSON string mapping field names to new values. Example: '{"gc_cycle_hours": 12, "soft_delete_grace_hours": 48}'
policy_updates.title: Policy Updates

session_id.description: Unused; policy is global, not per-session.
session_id.title: Session Id

upload_document.description:
Upload and index a document into the knowledge base.

The document is read from disk, its text is extracted (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, CSV, JSON, HTML, XML supported), split into overlapping chunks, and each chunk is embedded and stored in the vector database for fast retrieval.

When `wait=true` (default), the tool blocks until processing is complete and returns the final status.  When `wait=false`, the tool returns immediately with `status: "processing"`; use `get_document_status` to poll for completion.

Returns: JSON object with document_id, filename, status, chunks_count, and file_size_kb.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file on disk.
file_path.title: File Path

filename.description: Optional display name to override the basename of file_path.
filename.title: Filename

session_id.description: Session identifier; the document will only be visible within this session. Optional: without it, the server's session (RAG_SESSION_ID, or lasagna serve --mcp -s <session>).
session_id.title: Session Id

wait.description: If true (default), block until processing completes. If false, return immediately after dispatch.
wait.title: Wait
